* '''PC-E1''' ([[Colonel Jendon In Vader's Personal Shuttle (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 4, file created 17 June 2023: “Deploys -2 to Mustafar. May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Jendon, who provides ability of 2. If Vader armed with a lightsaber weapon card at a battleground, Force drain +1 here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Colonel Jendon In Vader's Personal Shuttle]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Colonel Jendon In Vader's Personal Shuttle]] (published 5 March 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Colonel Jendon In Vader’s Personal Shuttle”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
